initial_shortlist_rejections.ICAP: Original scikit-feature uses a running maximum rather than the paper's sum of clipped interaction penalties; a different criterion. Do not use it as a same-algorithm speed baseline.
initial_shortlist_rejections.TraceRatio: Original scikit-feature truncates all candidate features to the first k before the iterative search. Do not copy this search-space change.
initial_shortlist_rejections.FisherScore: Equivalent ordering to ANOVA F; not counted as another independent algorithm alongside ANOVA.
initial_shortlist_rejections.SPEC: Default complete-spectrum centered score overlaps the already retained Laplacian criterion; not selected for this batch.
initial_shortlist_rejections.f_classif: Mathematically correct Numba prototype lost to official scikit-learn on all screened shapes and thread counts; excluded from package. Replaced by MIFS.

fork_inspection: skfeature-chappers 1.2.1 inspected: DISR switches to a different formula after its first step; CIFE/MIFS wrappers consume LCSI ranks as though they were selected indices. Use pinned original upstream, with no source shims needed for this batch.
